content: The usual Teichmuller character ZMod p →*₀ ℤ_[p] (that I don't think we have) can easily be constructed via Perfection.teichmuller or WittVector.teichmuller. Which one should be preferred @Kenny Lau ?
Note that this is not exactly code duplication, since in the case the quotient is not perfect those maps are different.

Depending on your usage, there is also in my project https://github.com/acmepjz/lean-iwasawa/blob/48f39acb10e587ea71664a4dfc99b33002ae4ef5/Iwasawalib/NumberTheory/Padics/Units.lean#L155 with a more comprehensive API.

Riccardo Brasca said:

Note that this is not exactly code duplication, since in the case the quotient is not perfect those maps are different.

Do we already have the result that both constructions give the same result in the perfect case?
I don't know, but it shouldn't be that hard.
